body_text: We want children to fall in love with words, stories and the joy of expressing themselves, discovering the magic of reading and writing along the way.
title: Listening
text: Learning to listen, understand, respond and enjoy stories.
text_2: Finding their voice, building vocabulary and sharing ideas.

image.alt: Teacher reading a picture book to a group of children at story time

text_3: Discovering sounds, letters and words, and the joy of books.
text_4: Beginning with marks and drawings, then letters, words and sentences.
body_text_2: Our Letterland phonics programme gives a strong, systematic foundation in sounds and letters, always connected to stories, songs, movement, games and play. Our goal is confident communicators who have something to say, and the confidence to say it.
